data.title: 黍 · 逛市场时替你挑一只甜桃
data.description: 周末市场里，黍穿大荒农业天师原作衣装，托着挑好的桃子轻轻递向你。另一只手提着布袋，神情温和又带一点肯定，像是认真选出了你会喜欢的甜度；衣袖蓝色衬里和金绳扣在摊棚下清晰可见。
data.action: 一手递出挑好的桃子，一手提着布袋
data.promptProse: Under the market canopy, Shu offers a carefully chosen peach with one hand and holds a cloth shopping bag in the other. Her original white jacket reveals cobalt-blue lining and gold cord fastenings above illustrated white trousers. The eye-level cowboy view places the stall fruit near her and the market aisle behind. Soft morning light under the awning rounds the peach and gently illuminates her golden hands.
